ls -lh analysis/advanced-podcast-2026-10-25; python3 - <<'PY'
import numpy as np,json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('analysis/advanced-podcast-2026-10-25')
if (p/'recordings.json').exists(): print((p/'recordings.json').read_text())
if (p/'9P8H-rms-10ms.npy').exists() and (p/'AHQC-rms-10ms.npy').exists():
 a=np.load(p/'9P8H-rms-10ms.npy');b=np.load(p/'AHQC-rms-10ms.npy')
 # Pearson correlation for fixed windows, lag sign = B recording start relative to A.
 results=[]
 for start in [30,300,900,1700,1900,3000,3500,3700,4000]:
  scores=[]
  n=3000; x=a[int(start*100):int(start*100)+n].astype(float); x=(x-x.mean())/x.std()
  for lag in range(-12000,12001):
   bi=int(start*100)-lag
   if bi<0 or bi+n>len(b):continue
   y=b[bi:bi+n].astype(float); d=y.std()
   if d>1e-10:scores.append((float(np.dot(x,y-y.mean())/n/d),lag))
  scores.sort(reverse=True)
  results.append({'windowStartSeconds':start,'windowDurationSeconds':30,'bStartRelativeToASeconds':scores[0][1]/100,'correlation':scores[0][0]})
 (p/'sync-windows.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
PY
